declarations.description:
A raised button pinned to a corner of the viewport for the screen's main action ("Compose", "New task"). Give it
`c2-float-button-action` children and it becomes a speed dial: the button opens a short menu of related actions
that fan out in `direction`, its plus turning into a cross.

Without actions it is a plain button and fires the native `click`. With actions the button follows the menu-button
pattern: Enter, Space or an arrow key opens the dial and focuses the first action, the arrow keys move between
actions, Escape closes it and returns focus, and Tab or a click outside closes it.

The button is `position: fixed` 24px from the bottom-right corner by default; set `--c2-float-button--position`
and `--c2-float-button--inset` to place it elsewhere or in the flow. Show its `label` next to the icon (an
"extended" button) with `--c2-float-button__label--display: inline`.
declarations.name: FloatButton

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the button and its speed dial, also the visible text of an extended button. Defaults to "Actions".

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the speed dial is expanded. Has no effect without actions.

members.name: direction
members.description: Where the actions fan out from the button.

members.name: trigger
members.description: `hover` also opens the dial while a mouse pointer is over it; a click or the keyboard still toggle it.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the button and closes the dial.

members.name: openedByHover
members.description: The dial was opened by the mouse entering it, so the click that usually follows must not close it again.

members.name: actionList
members.description: The actions as last read, kept current by refreshActions.

members.name: actions
members.description:
The actions in DOM order, nearest the button first. They may sit in a framework's wrapper element (an Astro
island, a `display: contents` component root), so any descendant counts unless a nested float button owns it.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Opens or closes the speed dial.

events.description: An action was activated by a click, Enter or Space: `detail.value` and `detail.action`. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the dial open.
events.name: action-select

events.description: The speed dial opened or closed; `newState` is `open` or `closed`.

declarations.description:
One action of a `c2-float-button` speed dial: a small round button with a label chip beside it. The host is the
menu item (`role="menuitem"` through `ElementInternals`); the owning `c2-float-button` assigns the roving
`tabindex`, places the chip on the side that suits its `direction` and fires `action-select` when it is activated.
declarations.name: FloatButtonAction

cssProperties.description: Where the chip sits around the button. Defaults to the inline start for a vertical dial and above it for a horizontal one; set `50% auto auto calc(100% + 12px)` to put it on the right.
cssProperties.name: --c2-float-button-action__label--inset

cssProperties.description: Centres the chip on the button's axis; pair it with `--c2-float-button-action__label--inset` (`translateY(-50%)` beside, `translateX(-50%)` above).
cssProperties.name: --c2-float-button-action__label--transform

cssParts.description: The label chip beside the button.
cssParts.name: label

slots.description: The icon (an inline `<svg>`, a `c2-feather-*` or a `c2-mat-icon` element).
